package.description: Advanced Windows Network Adapter Profile & Diagnostics Tool

en-US.description: Advanced Windows Network Adapter Profile & Diagnostics Tool
en-US.longDescription: Etherprof is a fast, specialized Windows utility for network engineers and power users to quickly capture, manage, switch network adapter configurations (static IP, DHCP, gateway, DNS), monitor Wi-Fi, run continuous visual pings with history trails, and diagnose connection health.
en-US.name: Etherprof
